# sidecar.get_healpix_cell_geometry { #healpyxel.sidecar.get_healpix_cell_geometry }

```python
sidecar.get_healpix_cell_geometry(
    healpix_id,
    nside,
    nest=True,
    lon_convention='0_360',
)
```

Return a shapely Polygon for the given HEALPix cell.

Uses ``healpy.boundaries`` to retrieve the cell boundary vertices on the
unit sphere (Cartesian x, y, z), converts them to spherical coordinates,
and builds a planar lon/lat polygon.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type   | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|----------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| healpix_id     | int    | HEALPix cell index.                                                              | _required_ |
| nside          | int    | HEALPix nside parameter (power of 2).                                            | _required_ |
| nest           | bool   | If True, use NESTED ordering; otherwise RING.                                    | `True`     |
| lon_convention | str    | Longitude convention for the output polygon: ``'0_360'`` or ``'minus_plus180'``. | `'0_360'`  |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description                                                |
|--------|--------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | shapely.geometry.Polygon | Polygon representing the HEALPix cell boundary in lon/lat. |
